run_moolib_rpc_batched_server: run a moolib RPC server that defines batched methods and listens on a local address
create_rpc_client_connections: create multiple moolib RPC client instances that connect to a host and set timeouts
test_batched_rpc_calls: test batched RPC calls by sending async requests from multiple clients to a host
